test_case_name: Navigate to Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link and Interact with Cookie Banner

intents.intent: And then check that all cookies are accepted and the cookie banner is dismissed on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Access Cookie Options on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: Click 'PIÙ OPZIONI' on the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Skip to Content on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the focus is moved to the main content section on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Open and Submit Search on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: Click the button with class 'header-navbar-btn-search' to open search
Type $name in the input with placeholder 'Cerca'
Click the button with class 'btn-search' and data-name 'search-button'
And then check that the search results for $name are displayed on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Access 'Mobile ISP' App Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the accessibility statement for the 'Mobile ISP' app is displayed.

test_case_name: Switch Language to English on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the accessibility statement page is displayed in English.

test_case_name: Access User Area and Logout on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the user is logged out and the logout menu is displayed on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Access 'Il mio profilo' from User Area on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the user profile page is displayed within the user area on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Access 'Contatti' from User Area on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the contacts page is displayed from the user area on the accessibility statement page.

test_case_name: Access 'Iniziative riservate' from User Area on Accessibility Statement via 'Gruppo' Link

intents.intent: And then check that the reserved initiatives page is displayed from the user area on the accessibility statement page.
